2608.14881.title: Personalized Auto-Research: Towards a True AI Co-Scientist
2608.14881.paper_summary: AI co-scientists that generate hypotheses, retrieve related work, design experiments, execute code, and draft full papers are beginning to change how research is carried out. Despite this rapid progress, state-of-the-art systems remain researcher-agnostic: given a research goal, they optimize novelty, validity, or reviewer score while ignoring the individual scientist who will use the output. This overlooks a fundamental fact about research, namely, that what counts as novel, valuable, or feasible depends on the researcher, including their prior work, methodological repertoire, and the collaborators and communities in which they are embedded. In this work, we introduce the problem of personalized auto-research, which conditions every stage of the research process on a representation of the individual researcher. We argue that personalization is not a convenience layer, but rather the fundamental property that allows an AI system to serve as a genuine co-scientist rather than a generic instrument. To address this problem, we propose a general and flexible framework that threads a graph-grounded researcher context through retrieval, hypothesis search, experimentation, writing, and review. The framework consists of three fundamental components: (i) graph-grounded researcher representations, (ii) personalization across the full research pipeline, and (iii) evaluation grounded in the individual. Notably, we highlight a one-size-fits-all failure mode where distinct researchers issuing the same goal receive essentially the same research, erasing the tacit knowledge through which novel ideas arise. Finally, we discuss fundamental open problems and challenges.
2608.14881.paper_summary_zh: AI 共同科學家能夠生成假設、檢索相關工作、設計實驗、執行代碼並草擬完整論文，開始改變研究的進行方式。儘管這一快速進展，最先進的系統仍然對研究者保持中立：給定一個研究目標，它們優化新穎性、有效性或評審分數，同時忽略將使用輸出的個別科學家。這忽略了一個關於研究的基本事實，即什麼被視為新穎、有價值或可行，取決於研究者，包括他們的先前工作、方法論庫以及他們所嵌入的合作者和社群。在這項工作中，我們引入了個性化自動研究的問題，這使得研究過程的每個階段都依賴於對個別研究者的表徵。我們主張，個性化不是一種便利層，而是使 AI 系統能夠作為真正的共同科學家而非通用工具的基本特性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個通用且靈活的框架，將圖形基礎的研究者上下文貫穿於檢索、假設搜索、實驗、寫作和審查。該框架由三個基本組成部分組成：（i）圖形基礎的研究者表徵，（ii）貫穿整個研究管道的個性化，以及（iii）基於個體的評估。值得注意的是，我們強調了一種一刀切的失敗模式，其中不同的研究者針對相同目標發出基本相同的研究，抹去了新穎思想產生的隱性知識。最後，我們討論了基本的開放問題和挑戰。
